name: Double or Halve
description: 50% chance to double the Glyph's power; 50% chance to halve it.
mechanics: 50% to x2 or /2 the old effect value

name: -ING-
description: Transform this glyph into ING and increase its effect value by 7.
mechanics: It shouldn't work if the glyph was already the same letter

name: -ER-
description: Transform this glyph into ER and increase its effect value by 5.
mechanics: It shouldn't work if the glyph was already the same letter

name: -RE-
description: Transform this glyph into RE and increase its effect value by 5.
mechanics: It shouldn't work if the glyph was already the same letter

name: Erase
description: Delete this glyph from your deck.
mechanics: Removed from the match: hand and every pile

name: Last Letter +5
description: +5 if this glyph ends the word.
mechanics: If it is used at the end of the word +5

name: First Letter +5
description: +5 if this glyph starts the word.
mechanics: If it is used at the beginning of the word +5

name: Last Letter x2
description: Double this glyph's value if it ends the word.
mechanics: If it is used at the end of the word x2

name: First Letter x2
description: Double this glyph's value if it starts the word.
mechanics: If it is used at the beginning of the word x2

name: Vowel Start +10
description: +10 if the word starts with a vowel.
mechanics: If the word starts with a vowel +10

name: Five Letters +8
description: +8 if the word has exactly 5 letters.

name: Matching Ends x2
description: Double this glyph's value if the word's first and last letters match.
mechanics: If the first and last letters are the same x2
